header: THE FARES OF ONE TRAIN, opened from the "Fares" button on its row. FareBox asks the server (src/app/api/live/railway-fare) only when it is opened: the answer is the SAVED fares of the train (database, src/lib/live/fareStore.ts) with the date they were received, said first by ReceivedLine, because I use the paid fare service for one month only; FareTable is the plain picture of an answer. The words are the point: the figures are the railway reservation system's own for the day named, called APPROXIMATE (they can differ on the day), the source is named and linked, I say the unreserved fare is missing (and never make it up), and a class the train does not have is not listed.
